title: Statement Day, Payment Terms and Late Charge Limits on the Vending Services Program
content:
The day of the month a vending statement is raised, the calendar days from the statement within which payment is due, the monthly late charge on an overdue vending invoice, the grace days that pass before a late charge may be raised, the ceiling on the late charge raised against one vending invoice and the days past due at which restocking stops are printed against the programme the Vending Services Program agreement is written at.

| Programme | Day of the month the statement is raised | Calendar days from the statement within which payment is due | Monthly late charge on the overdue amount | Grace days before a late charge may be raised | Ceiling on the late charge against one invoice | Days past due at which restocking stops |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single Machine Snack Service | 5 | 15 | 1.50 percent | 3 | 80.00 | 45 |
| Snack & Cold Beverage Bank | 8 | 21 | 1.50 percent | 5 | 160.00 | 60 |
| Combination Vending Bank | 11 | 30 | 1.25 percent | 7 | 420.00 | 75 |
| Fresh Food Vending Service | 14 | 30 | 1.25 percent | 7 | 850.00 | 75 |
| Campus Vending Network Service | 17 | 45 | 1.00 percent | 10 | 2200.00 | 90 |
| Managed Vending & Kiosk Service | 21 | 30 | 1.00 percent | 10 | 1600.00 | 75 |

The statement day is a day of the month, and every statement day in this schedule falls between 1 and 28. The payment terms, the grace days and the credit hold figure are in calendar days. The late charge is a monthly percentage of the overdue amount, and its ceiling is an amount in US dollars stated against one vending invoice.

### The three day counts distinguished

Three of these figures are day counts and each is anchored differently. The payment terms are counted from the statement and say when the amount falls due. The grace days are counted past the due date and say how long passes before a late charge may be raised at all. The credit hold figure is counted past due and says at what point restocking stops. On the Combination Vending Bank the three stand at 30, 7 and 75 calendar days, and on the Campus Vending Network Service at 45, 10 and 90.

### Worked illustration of the ceiling (hypothetical amounts)

On the Single Machine Snack Service, where the monthly late charge is 1.50 percent and the ceiling against one invoice is 80.00, an overdue amount of 1000.00 yields a monthly late charge of 15.00, which stands below the ceiling. An overdue amount of 8000.00 would yield 120.00 at the same percentage, which stands above the ceiling of 80.00, so the charge raised against that invoice is held to 80.00. The overdue amounts chosen here are illustrative and are not programme figures.
